base_angular_velocity: IMU angular_velocity rotated by configured yaw offset unless fallback marked robot frame; reverse direction transform also applies
covariance_negative_one: not consulted by _effective_imu_state; code uses message values if timely; sentinel must not be interpreted here as measurement invalidity
fallback: angular velocity from /livox/imu_172_16_94_141 and map -> chassis/body TF orientation if primary stale
header_stamps: not passed in frontend payload; callback reception clock governs freshness
primary: /bno055/imu orientation and angular velocity, reception-age <= state_timeout 0.5s
projected_gravity: quaternion wxyz normalized; world (0,0,-1) rotated to body; yaw offset applied to sensor-frame primary; reverse direction flips body x/y
